id: 04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question
title: 安全知识问答：燃烧、火灾分类与灭火器
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/04_Fire Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Safety Officer Interview Question/src.py

points.K24: 灭火前先判断火灾类型并保持距离

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着消防头盔站在问答台后招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a red firefighter helmet, stands behind a quiz podium and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的题目：消防安全面试问答！
overlay: 安全知识问答：燃烧、火灾分类与灭火器

shots.scene: 四个图标：火焰、分类卡、灭火器、检查清单
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a flame, a set of category cards, a fire extinguisher and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 从火讲起，讲到灭火器检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰和面试官老周隔桌对坐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits across a desk from the older man in an interview room.
shots.narration: 阿杰在面试消防安全员。

shots.scene: 老周举起一张画着火焰的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds up a blank card with a flame icon and raises an eyebrow.
shots.narration: 第一题就问：火是什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣从旁边探出头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pops up beside the desk with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 我们一起来答。

shots.scene: 燃料、氧气、温度三个图标连成一圈，中间冒出火焰
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, fuel, oxygen and a thermometer, linked in a loop with a flame bursting in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 火：燃料、氧气、温度的化学链式反应。

shots.scene: 火焰放出热浪和光芒
shots.prompt_en: A flame giving off heat waves and bright light rays. No people.
shots.narration: 这个反应会产生热和光。

shots.scene: 木头、纸、油桶、气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of wood logs, paper, a fuel can and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料：木材、纸、汽油、柴油、甲烷。

shots.scene: 四个图标：燃料、空气、热源、链环
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a fuel can, air swirls, a heat source and interlocking chain links. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料、氧气、热量、链式反应。

shots.scene: 四个图标同时亮起，中间出现火焰
shots.prompt_en: The four icons light up together and a flame appears in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 四者同时具备，才会起火。

shots.scene: 三角形三边分别是燃料、热量、氧气
shots.prompt_en: A triangle with its three sides labeled by icons: fuel, heat and oxygen. No people.
shots.narration: 火三角：燃料、热量、氧气三要素。

shots.scene: 三角形旁边一个旧书图标
shots.prompt_en: The triangle next to an old dusty book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是旧的理论。

shots.scene: 彩色四面体，四个面各有一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A colorful tetrahedron with an icon on each face: fuel, heat, oxygen and chain links. No people.
shots.narration: 火四面体：再加上链式反应。

shots.scene: 房间三个角落分别放燃料、热源、空气图标，没有火
shots.prompt_en: A room with a fuel can in one corner, a heater in another and air swirls in a third, and no fire. No people.
shots.narration: 三样同在一个房间，也不一定起火。

shots.scene: 链环图标连上，火焰出现
shots.prompt_en: Chain link icons connect together and a flame appears. No people.
shots.narration: 发生链式反应才起火，现在通用四面体。

shots.scene: 左边六张分类卡，右边五张
shots.prompt_en: Six category cards on the left and five category cards on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 火灾分类：国际通用分六类。

shots.scene: 右边五张卡里，E卡被抽走
shots.prompt_en: In the right group the fifth card is pulled out, leaving five cards. No people.
shots.narration: 印度标准分五类，没有E类。

shots.scene: 纸、木头、橡胶、塑料图标在燃烧
shots.prompt_en: Icons of paper, wood, rubber and plastic burning. No people.
shots.narration: A类：固体，一般可燃物、有机物。

shots.scene: 汽油桶、柴油桶、油漆桶着火
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gasoline can, a diesel can and a paint can with flames. No people.
shots.narration: B类：易燃液体，汽油、柴油、油漆。

shots.scene: 三个气罐图标顶上冒火
shots.prompt_en: Three gas canister icons with flames at their valves. No people.
shots.narration: C类：可燃气体，丙烷、丁烷、甲烷。

shots.scene: 金属块图标冒出白亮火焰
shots.prompt_en: Metal chunk icons with bright white flames. No people.
shots.narration: D类：可燃金属，钠、钾、铀。

shots.scene: 电脑、电焊机、配电板图标冒火
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a computer, a welding machine and an electrical panel with flames. No people.
shots.narration: E类：带电的电气设备着火。

shots.scene: 电闸拉下，闪电图标消失
shots.prompt_en: A power switch is pulled down and the lightning bolt icon disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 切断电源后，就不再算电气火。

shots.scene: 炒锅里的油着火
shots.prompt_en: A frying pan with burning cooking oil on a stove. No people.
shots.narration: F类：厨房火，食用油和脂肪着火。

shots.scene: 五个灭火器并排，瓶颈色带不同
shots.prompt_en: Five red fire extinguishers side by side, each with a different colored band near the top. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器主要有五种。

shots.scene: 红色色带的灭火器，旁边A类卡带绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a bright red band next to a class card with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 水型：适用A类火。

shots.scene: 电气、厨房、气体火图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electrical fire, a kitchen fire and a gas fire, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用于电气火、厨房火和气体火。

shots.scene: 奶油色色带的灭火器，A、B卡带绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a cream band next to two class cards with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 泡沫：适用A类和B类火。

shots.scene: 三张类别卡打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three class cards crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用于F类、E类、D类火。

shots.scene: 蓝色色带的灭火器，A、B、C卡带绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a blue band next to three class cards with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉：适用ABC三类，叫ABC灭火器。

shots.scene: 厨房火和高压电图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A kitchen fire icon and a high voltage icon crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用于厨房火和1000伏以上电气火。

shots.scene: 低压电器上落满粉末
shots.prompt_en: A small electrical device covered in powder with a crack icon. No people.
shots.narration: 低压电气火能用，但容易损坏设备。

shots.scene: 黑色色带、喇叭形喷筒的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a black band and a wide horn-shaped nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳：适用电气火和B类火。

shots.scene: 三张类别卡打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three class cards crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用于A类、D类、F类火。

shots.scene: 黄色色带的灭火器，F卡带绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a yellow band next to a class card with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 湿式化学：适用F类厨房火。

shots.scene: 三张类别卡打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three class cards crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用于B类、D类、E类火。

shots.scene: 四面体旁四个图标：水滴、阀门、盖子、断开的链环
shots.prompt_en: A tetrahedron with four icons beside it: a water drop, a closed valve, a lid and a broken chain link. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火有四种方法。

shots.scene: 四面体的热量面被水流冲掉
shots.prompt_en: The heat face of the tetrahedron is washed away by a water spray. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却：带走热量，比如用水喷。

shots.scene: 老李关闭燃料管道阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns a valve wheel to shut off a fuel pipeline.
shots.narration: 隔离：移走燃料，关闭燃料供应。

shots.scene: 四面体的氧气面被盖子罩住
shots.prompt_en: The oxygen face of the tetrahedron is covered by a lid, next to a carbon dioxide cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 窒息：隔绝氧气，用二氧化碳或覆盖。

shots.scene: 四面体的链环面断开
shots.prompt_en: The chain link face of the tetrahedron breaks apart. No people.
shots.narration: 中断链式反应：打断燃烧链。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳云和盖子图标指向断开的链环
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide cloud icon and a lid icon point to the broken chain link. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说，也是用二氧化碳或覆盖。

shots.scene: 四格示意图：拔销、对准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: A four-panel diagram: pulling a pin, aiming a nozzle, squeezing a handle and sweeping side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 使用灭火器，记住PASS。

shots.scene: 小研拔掉灭火器保险销
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the safety pin out of a fire extinguisher at a training ground.
shots.narration: 第一步，拔掉保险销。

shots.scene: 小研把喷嘴对准火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student aims the nozzle at the base of a small training fire in a metal tray.
shots.narration: 第二步，对准火焰根部。

shots.scene: 小研压下压把，左右扫射
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squeezes the handle and sweeps the spray from side to side over the tray fire.
shots.narration: 第三步压下压把，第四步左右扫。

shots.section_title: 灭火前先判断火灾类型并保持距离
shots.scene: 欣欣举起火灾类别卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a set of fire class cards and picks one.
shots.narration: 先判断是什么火，选对灭火器。
overlay: 灭火前先判断火灾类型并保持距离

shots.section_title: 灭火前先判断火灾类型并保持距离
shots.scene: 人和火之间画出距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram holding an extinguisher with a distance arrow between them and the fire. No people.
shots.narration: 和火保持2米的安全距离。

shots.scene: 日历翻到新的一月，灭火器旁一个检查清单
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips to a new month next to a fire extinguisher and a blank checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器每月要做一次目视检查。

shots.scene: 压力表指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of an extinguisher pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 压力表在绿区，说明有药剂有压力。

shots.scene: 老李检查保险销、软管、喷嘴和压把
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the safety pin, hose, nozzle and handle of a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 查保险销、软管、喷嘴、压把。

shots.scene: 老李查看空白标签和筒体，旁边推车式灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a blank tag and the body of the extinguisher, with a wheeled extinguisher beside it.
shots.narration: 看有效期和筒体，推车式还要查推车。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现火四面体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating colorful tetrahedron.
shots.narration: 火有四要素，现在用四面体理论。

shots.scene: 六张火灾类别卡
shots.prompt_en: Six fire class cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 火灾分A到F六类。

shots.scene: 五个不同色带的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Five extinguishers with different colored bands. No people.
shots.narration: 五种灭火器，按色带识别、按类选用。

shots.scene: 四格PASS图和检查清单
shots.prompt_en: A four-panel action diagram and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 四种灭火法，PASS使用，每月检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣摘下消防头盔挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot takes off the red firefighter helmet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 消防知识记牢，面试加油，再见！
